expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Two cities, three nights each. The shared tours keep the price down and still cover the wall, the palace and the Bund.
expert.tip: Keep the Forbidden City for a weekday morning. Tickets are capped daily and the Saturday slots go first in Indian booking windows.

summary: Seven days across the two cities everyone asks for, with daily breakfast: the Great Wall at Mutianyu, the Summer Palace and the Forbidden City in Beijing, then a Huangpu cruise, Disneyland and the panda hall in Shanghai.
included: Included: 3 nights in Beijing and 3 nights in Shanghai with daily breakfast; private transfers; full day Great Wall at Mutianyu with the Summer Palace; Tiananmen Square and Forbidden City half day; Huangpu river cruise tickets; Shanghai Disneyland tickets; half day guided Shanghai city tour; Shanghai Zoo tickets.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Beijing to Shanghai internal flight; China visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
